item.title: Practical guides to FlowSight and local AI work
item.description: Explore practical FlowSight guides by Manuel Castillejo: app evaluation, AI-summary review, team pilots, meeting load and clear client handoffs.

item.title: Your first week reviewing work with FlowSight
item.description: A small trial plan for FlowSight: choose a question, check your version, review context and decide whether one adjustment helps your work.

item.title: How to review an AI work summary before sending it
item.description: A practical review workflow for FlowSight summaries: verify outcomes, correct interpretation, remove unnecessary detail and check the final report.

item.title: Questions to answer before a FlowSight team pilot
item.description: Define purpose, access, data selection and a review date before trying FlowSight with a team. Includes a pilot decision record.

item.title: Review meeting load without guessing from hours alone
item.description: Evaluate meeting purpose, placement, preparation and decisions alongside FlowSight work context. Use a downloadable meeting-audit worksheet.

item.title: How to identify the official FlowSight app and its creator
item.description: Find the FlowSight productivity app at flowsight.site, published source and Manuel Castillejo's public references. Distinguish unrelated products with similar names.

item.title: Turn work context into a clear client handoff
item.description: A client-handoff workflow for selecting verified outcomes, access instructions and open decisions from FlowSight summaries and project evidence.

item.title: FlowSight Complete App Guide
item.description: Welcome to FlowSight. Recover your FlowState. Watch the complete app guide: Clock, Pomodoro, local AI planning, Total Focus, Insights, reports, Coach, MCP, privacy and friend leagues.
